WHATSAPP PARENT - LANDOC MAIN V1 FRESH

This is a separate WhatsApp-only parent workflow.
It does NOT affect the existing website/Odoo bot.

Common service workflow reused:
SERVICE_MARRIAGE_REGISTRATION_V2_PaymentTest

Phase 1 target:
WhatsApp inbound -> session -> language/main menu -> marriage service -> save session -> WhatsApp reply.

Replace env placeholders in HTTP_Send_WhatsApp_Text or use your WhatsApp credential/node.

SAFE IMPORT NOTE

Import this as a NEW workflow only:
WHATSAPP_PARENT_LANDOC_MAIN_V1_FRESH

Do not overwrite website marriage registration workflow.
This workflow uses channel = whatsapp and customer_id = WhatsApp phone number.

Meta webhook verification note:

This workflow has POST inbound for message events.
For Meta GET verification, either:
1) Use n8n WhatsApp Trigger node instead of this webhook, OR
2) Create a small separate GET webhook verification workflow.

After Meta webhook is verified, POST messages can come here.

CREDENTIAL CHECK

WhatsApp Trigger:
- Use WhatsApp OAuth credential for the same Meta App.

WA_Send_Text_Direct and WA_Send_Text_After_Service:
- Select the correct WhatsApp Cloud API credential.
- Phone Number ID must be the active LANDOC bot/test phone number.
- Recipient is dynamic: {{$json.customer_id}}

Do not keep exposed permanent tokens in the workflow.

WHATSAPP PARENT - LANDOC MAIN V1 MARRIAGE REGISTRATION

Clean WhatsApp Trigger based parent workflow.
This workflow is separate from the website/Odoo bot and will NOT affect it.

Common service workflow reused:
SERVICE_MARRIAGE_REGISTRATION_V2_PaymentTest

Flow:
WhatsApp Trigger -> normalize -> session lookup -> language/main menu -> marriage service -> save session -> WhatsApp reply.

For production:
1) Use one WhatsApp Trigger only for this Meta App.
2) Select the correct WhatsApp credentials and Phone Number ID in both Send nodes.
3) Do not use hardcoded access tokens in HTTP nodes.

SAFE IMPORT NOTE

Import this as a NEW workflow:
WHATSAPP_PARENT_LANDOC_MAIN_V1_MARRIAGE_REGISTRATION

Do not overwrite:
website marriage registration 17_06_26_v2_PaymentTest

This workflow uses:
channel = whatsapp
customer_id = WhatsApp sender phone number

Existing service workflow remains common:
SERVICE_MARRIAGE_REGISTRATION_V2_PaymentTest

DOCUMENT UPLOAD HANDLER

This branch is WhatsApp-only and does NOT affect the website/Odoo bot.

When a customer uploads image/document media during document_collection:
1) It detects media from WhatsApp Trigger.
2) It reads the expected document from session/last reply, e.g. Groom Aadhaar Card.
3) It stores WhatsApp media metadata in session_data.uploaded_documents.
4) It marks the expected document as received_from_whatsapp.
5) It asks the next document if a checklist exists, otherwise it confirms receipt.

Important: This stores WhatsApp media id/metadata. To push binary files to Odoo checklist lines automatically, add your Odoo upload API after CODE_Handle_Document_Upload_Metadata.

DOCUMENT UPLOAD HANDLER - ODOO ATTACHMENT ENABLED

This branch is WhatsApp-only and does NOT affect the website/Odoo bot.

When customer uploads image/document media during document_collection:
1) Detect WhatsApp media.
2) Read expected document from session/last reply, e.g. Groom Aadhaar Card.
3) Get WhatsApp media URL.
4) Download binary file from WhatsApp.
5) Convert file to base64.
6) POST to Odoo endpoint: /api/v1/crm/lead/checklist/upload.
7) Save session and reply only after Odoo upload succeeds.

Configure required headers/tokens in the HTTP nodes before production.

CREDENTIAL CHECK

WhatsApp Trigger and WhatsApp Send nodes:
- Use WhatsApp OAuth / Cloud API credential for the same Meta App.
- Phone Number ID must be the active LANDOC bot/test phone number.

HTTP_Get_WhatsApp_Media_URL and HTTP_Download_WhatsApp_Media_File:
- Set Authorization header to Bearer {{$env.WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN}} or your secure WhatsApp token credential.

HTTP_Upload_Checklist_Attachment_To_Odoo:
- Set Odoo base URL and auth header required by _authenticate().
- Default endpoint path: /api/v1/crm/lead/checklist/upload.

Do not keep exposed permanent tokens in the workflow.
